description_en: Changes the instance type or storage space for ApsaraDB for MongoDB standalone, replica set, or serverless instances. Serverless instances are exclusive to the Alibaba Cloud China website
description_zh: 变更云数据库MongoDB单节点实例、副本集实例和Serverless实例（仅中国站支持Serverless实例）的规格或存储空间
name: ModifyDBInstanceSpec

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. <props="intl">For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149719.html operation to query instance types.</props><props="china"></props>

For a standalone instance or a replica set instance, this parameter specifies the instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149719.html operation to query the instance types of standalone and replica set instances.

For a serverless instance, this parameter specifies the computing capacity of the instance. Valid values: 100 to 8000.

You must configure one of the DBInstanceStorage and DBInstanceClass parameters
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格。<props="intl"><ph>详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html。您也可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149719.html接口查看实例规格。</ph></props>
<props="china">
单节点实例和副本集实例配置为实例的规格，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html。您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149719.html接口查看单节点实例和副本集实例的实例规格。
Serverless实例配置为实例的计算规格，取值范围为100~8000。
</props>

该参数和DBInstanceStorage参数两者中至少配置一项
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The storage capacity of the instance. <props="intl">The value must be an integer that is greater than or equal to 10. The value increases in increments of 10. Unit: GB. The values that can be specified for this parameter are subject to the instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html.</props>

<props="china">

The storage capacity of a standalone instance or a replica set instance must be a multiple of 10. The valid values are 10 to 3000. Unit: GB. The values that can be specified for this parameter are subject to the instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html.

The storage capacity of a serverless instance must be a multiple of 1. The valid values are 1 to 100. Unit: GB.

</props>

You must configure one of the DBInstanceClass and DBInstanceStorage parameters.

You cannot decrease the storage capacity of an instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例的存储空间。<props="intl"><ph>取值范围为10~3000 GB，步长为10 GB。具体取值受实例规格约束，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html。</ph></props>

<props="china">
单节点实例和副本集实例存储空间的取值范围为10~3000 GB，步长为10 GB。具体取值受实例规格约束，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html。
Serverless实例存储空间的取值范围1~100 GB，步长为1 GB。
</props>

该参数和DBInstanceClass参数两者中至少配置一项。
目前不支持降配存储空间
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The specification change type. Valid values:

UPGRADE: upgrades the specifications. This is the default value.

DOWNGRADE: downgrades the specifications.

This parameter is available only for subscription instances
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型，取值说明：
UPGRADE：默认值，升级配置。
DOWNGRADE：降级配置。

当实例付费方式为包年包月时，可以配置该参数
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment for the instance. Valid values:

true: enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account has a sufficient balance. This is the default value.

<props="china">

false: disables automatic payment. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console to pay for the instance. In the upper-right corner of the page, choose Billing Management > Billing Management. In the left-side navigation pane, choose Orders > My Orders. On the Product Orders tab, find the order and complete the payment.

</props>


<props="intl">

false: disables automatic payment. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console to pay for the instance. In the upper-right corner of the page, choose Billing Management > Billing Management. In the left-side navigation pane, click Orders. On the Product Orders page, find the order and complete the payment.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否自动付费，取值说明：
true：默认值，自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
<props="china">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，选择订购订单>我的订单，在商品订单页签找到目标订单进行支付。</props>
<props="intl">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，单击订单管理，在商品订单页面找到目标订单进行支付。</props>
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes in the instance. Default value: 3.

Valid values for replica set instances: 3, 5, and 7.

The value for standalone instances is fixed at 1.

The value for replica set instances with shared storage (available only in the China site) is fixed at 2.

This parameter is not required for serverless instances (available only in the China site)
parameters.help_zh:
设置实例的节点个数，默认值为3。
副本集实例取值为3，5，7。
单节点实例取值固定为1。
共享存储版副本集实例（仅支持中国站）取值固定为2。

Serverless实例（仅支持中国站）不需要配置该参数
parameters.name: replication_factor

parameters.help_en:
The number of read-only nodes. Valid values: 0 to 5.

If the network type of the instance is set to only classic network and VPC, you need to enable public access or release the classic network endpoint before you can change the number of read-only nodes.

You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console and go to the Database Connections page to view the network types that have been enabled
parameters.help_zh:
只读节点的个数，取值范围为0~5。

如果实例的网络类型只开通了经典网络和专有网络，您需要开通公网或释放经典网络，才能变更只读节点数。
您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在数据库连接页面查看已开通的网络类型
parameters.name: readonly_replicas

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:

default or null (default): A coupon is used.

youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank: No coupon is used
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
default或null（默认）：使用优惠券。
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
The effective time of the configuration change. Valid values:

Immediately: The configuration change immediately takes effect. This is the default value.

MaintainTime: The configuration change takes effect during the maintenance window of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
变更配置的生效时间，取值说明：
Immediately：默认值，立即生效。
MaintainTime：在实例的可运维时间段内生效
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
Additional parameters. Valid values:

async: The result is returned after the specification change order is created.

sync: The result is returned after the instance specification change is delivered
parameters.help_zh:
附加参数，取值说明：

async：变配订单创建后返回结果。
sync：变配订单创建后实例变配下发时返回结果
parameters.name: extra_param

parameters.help_en:
The destination zone to which you want to migrate the instance when you change the specifications and migrate the instance across zones.
<notice>This parameter applies only to cloud disk instances.></notice>
<notice>The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the TargetSecondaryZoneId or TargetHiddenZoneId parameter.></notice>

You must specify this parameter only when you change the specifications and migrate the instance across zones.

The destination zone and the current zone must be in the same region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query zone IDs
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配时，实例迁移的目标可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
<notice>该参数取值不能与TargetSecondaryZoneId和TargetHiddenZoneId参数值相同。></notice>
只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数。
迁移的目标可用区和当前实例的可用区处于同一地域。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: target_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination secondary zone for the secondary node when you change the specifications and migrate the instance across zones.
<notice>This parameter applies only to cloud disk instances.></notice>
<notice>The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the TargetZoneId or TargetHiddenZoneId parameter.></notice>

You must specify this parameter only when you change the specifications and migrate the instance across zones.

This parameter is available only for multi-zone migration.

The destination zone and the current zone must be in the same region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query zone IDs
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配时，从节点（Secondary节点）的目标可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
<notice>该参数取值不能与TargetZoneId和TargetHiddenZoneId参数值相同。></notice>

只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数。
本参数仅在多可用区迁移时可用。
迁移的目标可用区和当前实例的可用区处于同一地域。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: target_secondary_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination zone for the hidden node when you change the specifications and migrate the instance across zones.
<notice>This parameter applies only to cloud disk instances.></notice>
<notice>The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the TargetZoneId or TargetSecondaryZoneId parameter.></notice>

You must specify this parameter only when you change the specifications and migrate the instance across zones.

This parameter is available only for multi-zone migration.

The destination zone and the current zone must be in the same region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query zone IDs
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配时，隐藏节点（Hidden节点）的目标可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
<notice>该参数取值不能与TargetZoneId和TargetSecondaryZoneId参数值相同。></notice>


只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数。
本参数仅在多可用区迁移时可用。
迁移的目标可用区和当前实例的可用区处于同一地域。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: target_hidden_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination vSwitch ID when you change the specifications and migrate the instance across zones.
<notice>This parameter applies only to cloud disk instances.></notice>

You must specify this parameter only when you change the specifications and migrate the instance across zones
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配的目标虚拟交换机ID。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>

只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数
